name: Sleep Sensor
subtitle: Snoring & teeth grinding log
promo: Find out if you snore or grind your teeth. Put your phone by the bed; get a morning report with clips. 100% on-device.
description:
Do you snore or grind your teeth? Put your phone by the bed tonight and find out. In the morning you get a report with the loudest moments to play back.

Everything is analysed on your phone: your audio never leaves it. No account needed.

KEY FEATURES:
• Snoring and teeth grinding (bruxism) detection, told apart from quiet sleep and background noise.
• Morning report: total time, snoring and grinding minutes, a sleep timeline and a severity breakdown.
• Loudest moments: short clips of snoring and grinding with time and loudness, so you can hear it yourself.
• Works overnight with the screen locked on your bedside table.
• History and trends across nights.
• 100% private and on-device: sound analysis runs locally, works in Airplane mode, no sign-up.
• Bedtime reminder, adjustable microphone sensitivity and optional dB calibration.

IMPORTANT: SleepSensor is a general wellness and sleep sound logger. It is not a medical device and does not diagnose, treat, cure or prevent sleep apnea, bruxism or any other medical condition. If you are concerned about your sleep or breathing, talk to a doctor.
